steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for ce, cette and ces, then notice where ne...pas sits around the verb. The customer and clerk use vous.

steps.title: Looking for a sweater
steps.body: A customer asks about a size in a clothing store.

examples.en: Client: Hello. I am looking for a sweater.
Commis: This sweater is on sale.

examples.fr: Vous avez cette taille en noir ?
examples.en: Client: Do you have this size in black?

examples.fr: Non, je n'ai pas cette taille.
examples.en: Commis: No, I do not have this size.

examples.fr: D'accord. Je ne veux pas ce chandail.
examples.en: Client: Okay. I do not want this sweater.

examples.fr: Cette chemise est aussi en solde.
examples.en: Commis: This shirt is also on sale.
Client: Thank you. I will look.

steps.title: At the grocery checkout
steps.body: Julie buys apples and asks for a bag.

examples.fr: Bonjour. Je voudrais un kilo de pommes.
examples.en: Julie: Hello. I would like a kilogram of apples.
Caissière: Do you have a reusable bag?

examples.fr: Non, je n'ai pas de sac.
examples.en: Julie: No, I do not have a bag.
Caissière: Here is this paper bag.

examples.fr: Merci. J'ai un coupon de réduction.
examples.en: Julie: Thank you. I have a discount coupon.
Caissière: Okay. Here is the receipt.

steps.prompt: What size does the customer ask about?
steps.explain: She asks, Vous avez cette taille en noir ?

steps.prompt: Why does the customer not take the sweater?
options: The clerk does not have that size
steps.explain: The clerk says, je n'ai pas cette taille.

steps.prompt: What quantity of apples does Julie ask for?
steps.explain: Julie asks for un kilo de pommes.
She says, Je paie par carte.
